assessments.reasoning:
The instrument captures individual economic maintenance and property/asset control at the member level, but does not fully capture labor burden or household decision-making spheres:
- economic_maintenance: TRUE. Section G captures individual income at member level across various sources (wages in g.3, pensions in g.30, alimony in g.43, independent work earnings in g.23).
- labor_burden: FALSE. While hours in paid work are captured at member level (f.42), the instrument does not capture hours spent on unpaid domestic or care work (f.82 only captures a binary Yes/No on performing household chores).
- property_asset_control: TRUE. Section H records property ownership at the member level, identifying specific member numbers for dwelling ownership (h.7) and asking about individual ownership of other real estate/assets (h.8, h.10, h.14, h.16, h.20).
- decision_making: FALSE. The questionnaire includes decision-making questions only regarding independent business management (f.24) and lacks questions on intra-household decision-making across spheres such as child-rearing, daily consumption, or major financial choices.
